newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-INJURED HELMER AND BASLER OUT OF GERMAN SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-INJURED HELMER AND BASLER OUT OF GERMAN SQUAD.

text.p: German coach Berti Vogts left European championship defender Thomas Helmer and midfielder Mario Basler, both injured, out of his final 19-man squad on Sunday for a World Cup qualifier against Northern Ireland on November 9.
Vogts also opted to omit Bayer Leverkusen striker Ulf Kirsten in favour of Borussia Dortmund's Heiko Herrlich.
"Ulf moves better but Heiko has in his favour that he's getting the goals, most recently in the Champions' League," Vogts said.
As expected, Vogts also decided to leave behind another of his Euro '96 squad, striker Stefan Kuntz, along with Bochum's up-and-coming midfield dynamo Dariusz Wosz.
"Stefan will come when we need him. I know what he can do, he doesn't need to prove it to me in training," Vogts said.
The group nine match is set for Nuremberg's Frankenstadion.
Defenders - Markus Babbel, Juergen Kohler, Stephan Passlack, Stefan Reuter, Thomas Schneider
Midfielders - Marco Bode, Dieter Eilts, Thomas Haessler, Joerg Heinrich, Andreas Moeller, Mehmet Scholl, Thomas Strunz, Michael Tarnat
Forwards - Oliver Bierhoff, Fredi Bobic, Heiko Herrlich, Juergen Klinsmann.
